# Synthetic Reports

Use this folder for staging/UAT only.

Do not place real customer credit reports here.

Required synthetic report names:

- `equifax_synthetic_positive_negative.pdf`
- `experian_synthetic_positive_negative.pdf`
- `transunion_synthetic_positive_negative.pdf`

The placeholder files in this folder are not real reports. Replace them only with synthetic/test reports built for UAT.
